lessons.title: What a shader is
lessons.summary: A fragment shader is a small function that runs once for every pixel: it takes the pixel's position and returns a colour.

lessons.title: The rendering pipeline: from three vertices to pixels
lessons.summary: Follow one triangle through the GPU: the vertex shader places its corners, the rasteriser finds the covered pixels, and the fragment shader colours each one.

lessons.title: UV coordinates: one shader for every screen size
lessons.summary: Three lines turn pixel positions into UVs: divide by the resolution, centre the origin, and fix the aspect ratio so circles stay round.

lessons.title: Colour as vectors: add, multiply and swizzle
lessons.summary: A colour in a shader is a vec3 of red, green and blue. Add it to brighten, multiply it to tint, and swizzle it to reorder the channels.

lessons.title: Step and smoothstep: hard edges and soft edges
lessons.summary: step turns a value into a hard 0 or 1 at an edge; smoothstep blends across a band instead. Together they draw every edge a shader makes.
